mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS "id", o.platform_order_no AS "orderNo", o.store_id AS "storeId", s.name AS "storeName", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "site", o.status AS "status", o.local_status AS "localStatus", o.fulfillment AS "fulfillment", o.order_type AS "orderType", o.ship_country AS "country", o.currency AS "currency", o.total_amount AS "totalAmount", o.total_base AS "totalBase", o.weight AS "weight", o.exception AS "exception", o.hold_reason AS "holdReason", o.est_profit AS "estProfit", o.est_profit_rate AS "estProfitRate", o.buyer_name AS "buyerName", o.order_time AS "orderTime", o.remote_area AS "remoteArea", o.address_invalid AS "addressInvalid", o.blacklist_id AS "blacklistId", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM ecom_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS "itemQty" FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT i.seller_sku FROM ecom_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.seller_sku IS NOT NULL
SELECT t.name FROM ecom_order_tag_link l JOIN ecom_order_tag t ON t.id = l.tag_id WHERE l.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY t.sort, t.id

SELECT t.id AS "id", t.store_id AS "storeId", s.name AS "storeName", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "site", t.buyer_name AS "buyerName", t.subject AS "subject", t.last_message AS "lastMessage", t.last_message_time AS "lastMessageTime", t.reply_deadline AS "replyDeadline", t.order_id AS "orderId", t.platform_order_no AS "orderNo", t.owner_id AS "ownerId", t.tags AS "tags", t.unread AS "unread" FROM ecom_message_thread t JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = t.store_id WHERE t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.reply_deadline < #{now} ORDER BY t.reply_deadline LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS "id", c.name AS "name", c.store_id AS "storeId", c.ad_type AS "adType", c.daily_budget AS "dailyBudget", c.tags AS "tags", s.name AS "storeName", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "site", s.currency AS "currency", SUM(t.spend) AS "spend", SUM(t.sales) AS "sales", SUM(t.orders) AS "orders", SUM(t.clicks) AS "clicks", SUM(t.impressions) AS "impressions" FROM ecom_ad_campaign c JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = c.store_id JOIN ecom_ad_stat t ON t.campaign_id = c.id AND t.level = 'CAMPAIGN' AND t.stat_date >= #{from} AND t.stat_date <= #{to} WHERE c.status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.store_id, c.ad_type, c.daily_budget, c.tags, s.name, s.platform, s.marketplace, s.currency HAVING SUM(t.spend) > 0

SELECT c.id AS "id", c.name AS "name", c.store_id AS "storeId", c.ad_type AS "adType", c.daily_budget AS "dailyBudget", c.tags AS "tags", s.name AS "storeName", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "site", s.currency AS "currency", t.stat_date AS "statDate", t.spend AS "spend", t.sales AS "sales" FROM ecom_ad_campaign c JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = c.store_id JOIN ecom_ad_stat t ON t.campaign_id = c.id AND t.level = 'CAMPAIGN' WHERE c.status = 'ENABLED' AND c.daily_budget > 0 AND t.stat_date >= #{since} AND t.stat_date = (SELECT MAX(x.stat_date) FROM ecom_ad_stat x WHERE x.campaign_id = c.id AND x.level = 'CAMPAIGN') AND t.spend * 100 >= c.daily_budget * #{minUsage}

SELECT c.id AS "id", c.claim_no AS "claimNo", c.claim_type AS "claimType", c.store_id AS "storeId", s.name AS "storeName", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "site", c.seller_sku AS "sku", c.fnsku AS "fnsku", c.qty AS "qty", c.est_amount AS "estAmount", c.currency AS "currency", c.event_date AS "eventDate", c.deadline AS "deadline" FROM ecom_fba_claim c JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = c.store_id WHERE c.status = 'PENDING' AND c.deadline IS NOT NULL AND c.deadline >= #{today} AND c.deadline <= #{until} ORDER BY c.deadline

SELECT o.store_id AS "storeId", i.seller_sku AS "sku", SUM(i.qty) AS "qty", COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS "orders" FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{since} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND i.seller_sku IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.store_id, i.seller_sku

SELECT r.store_id AS "storeId", ri.seller_sku AS "sku", SUM(ri.qty) AS "qty", COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS "returns", MAX(ri.material_id) AS "materialId" FROM ecom_return r JOIN ecom_return_item ri ON ri.return_id = r.id WHERE r.create_time >= #{since} AND r.status <> 'CLOSED' AND ri.seller_sku IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.store_id, ri.seller_sku

SELECT l.id AS "listingId", l.store_id AS "storeId", l.seller_sku AS "sku", l.title AS "title", l.price AS "price", COALESCE(l.currency, s.currency) AS "currency", l.material_id AS "materialId", l.platform_item_id AS "itemId", s.name AS "storeName", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "site", c.lowest_price AS "competitorPrice", c.buybox_price AS "buyboxPrice", c.buybox_winner AS "buyboxWinner", c.offer_count AS "offerCount", c.competitor AS "competitor", c.snapshot_time AS "snapshotTime" FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id JOIN ecom_competitor_price c ON c.listing_id = l.id WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.price > 0 AND c.snapshot_time >= #{since} AND c.lowest_price IS NOT NULL AND c.lowest_price < l.price AND c.id = (SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM ecom_competitor_price x WHERE x.listing_id = l.id)

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.supplier_id IS NULL AND u.customer_id IS NULL AND ur.role_id IN #{id}
SELECT r.id, r.name FROM sys_role r WHERE r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort, r.id
SELECT u.id AS "id", u.nickname AS "nickname" FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id IN #{id}
